subject: CareBridge vendor intake blocking technical walkthrough — timeline and next steps
messages:
From: Elena Morozova <elena@carebridge.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@carebridge.com; Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@carebridge.com>
Date: 2027-05-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Scheduling technical walkthrough — vendor intake items outstanding

Hi Rishi,

Thanks for lining up the technical walkthrough. I need to flag that procurement and InfoSec have put this on hold until we close a couple of gating items:

- Completed vendor security questionnaire (attached) — procurement is doing an initial triage today.
- Executed NDA — legal requires DocuSign before product access.
- Confirmation of hosting/network model and data retention window (Tom's team will follow up).

Can we pause the live demo for now? We are aiming to get the questionnaire reviewed by EOD Tuesday (May 4), and legal hopes to send the NDA for signature by tomorrow if there are no major comments.

If you want, we can tentatively look at the week of May 10 for a new walkthrough, but I don't want you to build a deep agenda until procurement confirms.

Apologies for the churn — procurement cycles are longer than expected on our end.

Elena Morozova
Director, Vendor Programs
CareBridge Health

Attachment: CareBridge_Vendor_Questions.xlsx (xlsx, 68KB)

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Morozova <elena@carebridge.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-05-01T11:00:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Scheduling technical walkthrough — vendor intake items outstanding

Hi Elena — thanks for the heads up and for sharing the questionnaire. We can definitely pause the external demo until procurement and legal sign off. A few quick items from our side so we can move quickly when you are ready: 

- I attached our vendor intake checklist and a short security overview to help pre-fill common answers (redwood_vendor_checklist.pdf).
- If procurement wants, we can set up a quick 20-minute intake call with our Security lead (Laura) to go over questionnaire items that typically need clarifying.
- Please send the DocuSign link for the NDA when it's available; we will prioritize signature.

Tentative availability for week of May 10: Tue 5/11 10:00–11:00 PT or Wed 5/12 13:00–14:00 PT. If one of those windows works, we will block it tentatively and mark as "subject to intake completion."

Let me know if you want Laura to take a look at the questionnaire first — she can pull the most relevant fields we typically need to evidence (SSO, retention, encryption).

Best,

Rishi Malhotra
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rishi@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0163

Attachment: redwood_vendor_checklist.pdf (pdf, 24KB)

From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-05-01T14:20:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Scheduling technical walkthrough — vendor intake items outstanding

Rishi / Monica — internal note only (keeping thread context).

Agree with pausing external presentation until we have: signed NDA + procurement triage outcome + list of security controls they need evidence for. If they want an intake call, I can join and run through the questionnaire answers we normally provide.

Quick proposals (we can tentatively hold both):
- Tue May 11, 10:00–11:00 PT — technical walkthrough slot (open)
- Wed May 12, 13:00–14:00 PT — fallback (good for EMEA overlaps if needed)

Action items for us:
- Rishi: ask procurement to confirm DocuSign link and whether they prefer our redwood_vendor_checklist as a starting doc.
- Monica: prepare a one-page security bullet list (SSO, data residency, encryption at rest/in transit, token handling) to attach in replies.

I'll stand by for intake call scheduling. If they push later in May, we should avoid carving out too many engineer-hours until NDA is signed.

Laura Bennett
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
laura@redwoodinference.com

From: Elena Morozova <elena@carebridge.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@carebridge.com>; procurement@carebridge.com
Date: 2027-05-02T15:40:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Scheduling technical walkthrough — vendor intake items outstanding

Hi Rishi — quick update: 

- Procurement completed a preliminary review of the questionnaire this morning and had two minor clarifying questions (Tom copied).
- Legal has just sent the NDA via DocuSign; I signed it and routed to our procurement admin to countersign. You should see the DocuSign link shortly.
- We are comfortable moving forward with a tentative demo on Tue May 11 at 10:00 PT provided the countersigned NDA comes through by EOD Monday.

I attached the signed copy of the version I signed (signed_nda.pdf) as internal confirmation — procurement will upload the countersigned copy into our contract portal once it's complete.

If you can send a calendar invite for May 11 10:00–11:00 PT and include Laura for the intake/tech points, that would be great. If countersign doesn't land in time, we'll push to the week of May 17.

Thanks — appreciate the flexibility.

Elena Morozova
Director, Vendor Programs
CareBridge Health

Attachment: signed_nda.pdf (pdf, 120KB)

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwoodinference.com>, Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@carebridge.com>
Date: 2027-05-02T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Scheduling technical walkthrough — vendor intake items outstanding

Elena — thanks for the update and for getting the NDA moving. I will: 

1) Send a tentative calendar invite for Tue May 11, 10:00–11:00 PT marked "Subject to countersigned NDA."
2) Add Laura and Monica as presenters for intake + technical deep dive and include the one-pager security summary.
3) Hold the slot for 24 hours and release if countersign isn't complete by EOD Monday.

If procurement uploads the countersigned NDA earlier, we'll update the invite to confirmed and share a short agenda (15 min intake / 35 min demo / 10 min Q&A).

See invite shortly.

Best,
